subject: Request: Split invoicing cadence + conditional Net-90 — Heliox Systems
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@helioxsys.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Heliox Billing <billing@helioxsys.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: split invoicing cadence + net-90 for upcoming contract

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement and finance at Heliox are asking if we can accommodate a split invoicing cadence for our enterprise contract. Specifically:

- Invoice quarterly (4 invoices/year) for subscription fees rather than monthly.
- Provide a conditional Net-90 payment term for each invoice for the first 12 months while we align our ACH setup and internal PO cycles.

I attached a draft PO and their standard payment request form (PO_Heliox_0427.pdf). The ask is time-sensitive: our board approves vendor spend at the end of this month, and they want the billing cadence and payment terms reflected in the SOW/addendum.

Could you advise what approvals we need on Redwood's side and whether a short-term Net-90 pilot + quarterly invoicing is feasible? Happy to provide any procurement docs.

Best,
Sara Lim
VP, Procurement — Heliox Systems

--
Heliox Systems
billing@helioxsys.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@helioxsys.com>, Heliox Billing <billing@helioxsys.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: split invoicing cadence + net-90 for upcoming contract

Karthik / Marissa — looping you in for deal desk + finance input.

Summary: Heliox (deal HXL-2027-042) is asking for quarterly invoicing and a 12-month conditional Net-90 window for each invoice while they complete their ACH/PO onboarding. They attached a draft PO. They are asking for the billing terms to be reflected in the SOW before board sign-off at month-end.

My recommendation: consider a limited Net-90 pilot tied to a small usage credit or escrow safeguard, and accept quarterly invoicing for subscription line items only (usage/overages billed monthly). We should require:
- Contract addendum that explicitly limts Net-90 to 12 months and lists remedies (late fee or hold on new capacity if >1 missed payment).
- Prepayment or minimum first invoice upon signature (we can discuss amount).
- Finance to waive standard collections hold for this customer for the pilot if approved.

Risks: cash flow impact at ~USD 250k ARR, potential precedent setting for other large education/energy customers.

Attachments: I will add a suggested clause draft (heliox_addendum_draft.docx) and the payment matrix (payment_terms_grid.xlsx) in follow-up.

Can we get an exec sign-off if Finance is comfortable? Karthik, any extra risk flags to call out? Markus, tagging you for finance/approval.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: split invoicing cadence + net-90 for upcoming contract

Markus / Marissa — quick context and recommended guardrails.

Context: Heliox is a strategic target (energy vertical), expected first-year ARR ~250k, annual renewal potential if onboarding goes well. They asked for quarterly invoices + Net-90 for the first year. Their procurement team has long approval cycles and will not change PO cadence before this quarter close.

Recommended guardrails for a conditional approval:
- Limit Net-90 to subscription fees only; usage/overages invoice monthly and due Net-30.
- Require a \"conditional credit\" equal to 10% of first-year committed value held in escrow (or applied as usage credit) that releases after 12 months of timely payments.
- Include a single grace period clause and accelerate payment terms to Net-30 if >1 invoice is late by 30+ days.
- No upfront discount beyond standard enterprise pricing; instead offer a one-time onboarding credit (max USD 7,500) to offset cash timing.

Attachments: payment_terms_grid.xlsx (internal) — shows estimated cashflow impact and suggested credit structure.

If Finance signs off, Legal should prepare a one-page addendum and a DocuSign envelope. I recommend exec approval limited to this deal id HXL-2027-042 and non-precedential language.

Karthik
Head of Deal Desk (acting)
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/HXL-2027-042
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@helioxsys.com>, Heliox Billing <billing@helioxsys.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: split invoicing cadence + net-90 for upcoming contract

Thanks for the clear summary and recommendations. I approve a conditional Net-90 pilot and quarterly invoicing for Heliox (deal HXL-2027-042) under the following explicit conditions:

1) Net-90 applies only to subscription invoices for a fixed 12-month pilot period starting on the effective date. Usage/overages will be invoiced monthly and remain Net-30.
2) Heliox will provide either: (a) a 10% of first-year committed value held in an escrow arrangement OR (b) a refundable usage credit equal to 10% applied against invoices over the 12 months. Finance will confirm the exact mechanism with Heliox Billing.
3) Include a one-time onboarding credit of USD 5,000 (not a recurring discount) to offset their setup costs — to be recorded as a contra-revenue line item.
4) If Heliox fails to pay more than one invoice 30 days past term during the pilot, terms will revert to Net-30 and Redwood may suspend service per existing TOS.
5) Legal to prepare a one-page addendum and DocuSign envelope; include non-precedential language specifying this is a time-limited exception and requires executive renewal to extend.

Marissa / Legal: please prepare the addendum and DocuSign today so Grace can get the SOW finalized before Heliox's board meeting. Karthik / Finance: confirm which escrow vs. credit option is viable and who will own enforcement.

Markus Klein
VP, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
--
Redwood Inference | Finance Operations
